List the named sources of references

Source: R/ts_sources.R
ts_show_ref_sources.Rd

The sources that ts_load_ref() can download by name, with their licenses and how to cite them. Check the license of a source before reusing its data.

ts_show_ref_sources()

Value

A dataframe with one row per source and columns source (the name to give to ts_load_ref(source = )), name, description, license, citation and url.

Examples

ts_show_ref_sources()
#>   source                                                 name
#> 1    wfo                        World Flora Online Plant List
#> 2    ppg Pteridophyte Phylogeny Group classification (PPG II)
#>                                                                      description
#> 1 Plants (vascular plants and bryophytes); a new version every June and December
#> 2                          Ferns and lycophytes; a new version about every month
#>     license
#> 1   CC0 1.0
#> 2 CC BY 4.0
#>                                                                                                                                                 citation
#> 1                                               The World Flora Online Consortium. World Flora Online Plant List. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7460141
#> 2 Pteridophyte Phylogeny Group. PPG taxonomic database. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22760360. See also PPG I (2016) https://doi.org/10.1111/jse.12229
#>                                   url
#> 1           https://wfoplantlist.org/
#> 2 https://github.com/pteridogroup/ppg
